YUNO_MOD_RELIC_RADAR_DIARY_RELIC.title: Indiscriminate Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT21_THE_WORLD_RELIC.d: After you play [blue]12[/blue] cards, gain an [gold]extra turn[/gold] at the end of the turn; can only trigger once per combat.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT20_JUDGEMENT_RELIC.d: At the start of combat, a random enemy gains [gold]Judgment[/gold]. Damage you deal to enemies with [gold]Judgment[/gold] is increased by [blue]50[/blue]%, and damage you deal to enemies without [gold]Judgment[/gold] is reduced by [blue]50[/blue]%. When an enemy dies, its Judgment transfers to another enemy.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT19_THE_SUN_RELIC.des: At the start of combat, send [gold]Curse/Status[/gold] cards from your draw pile to your discard pile. When you draw a [gold]Curse/Status[/gold] card, Exhaust it.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_RADAR_DIARY_RELIC.descrip: Once only, after right-clicking this relic, return to the bottom of the tower.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_RADAR_DIARY_RELIC.flavor: Like a radar, it foresees everything around you.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_SEARCH_DIARY_RELIC.title: Tracking Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_SEARCH_DIARY_RELIC.descri:
At the start of your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
When you deal [gold]single-target damage[/gold] to a target with a card, the target gains [gold]Gaze[/gold] and other targets lose [gold]Gaze[/gold].
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BLOOD_DAGGER_RELIC.title: Bloodstained Dagger
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BLOOD_DAGGER_RELIC.descri: At the start of combat, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Maim[/gold] to all enemies.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BLOOD_DAGGER_RELIC.flavor: There is still blood residue on it.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BREED_DIARY_RELIC.title: Proliferation Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BREED_DIARY_RELIC.descrip: Once per combat, after you play a power card, add [blue]1[/blue] copy of the same power card with Ethereal to your hand.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_KILLING_DIARY_RELIC.title: Murder Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_KILLING_DIARY_RELIC.descr: Enemies with an [gold]attack intent[/gold] take [blue]50[/blue]% more damage.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_SEEK_DIARY_RELIC.title: Search Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_SEEK_DIARY_RELIC.descript: At the start of combat, randomly add [blue]1[/blue] skill card from your draw pile to your hand; that card costs 0 this combat.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_SEEK_DIARY_RELIC.selectio: Choose [blue]1[/blue] skill card to add to your hand
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_SEEK_DIARY_RELIC.flavor: When there are no cases to work, it is just a brick.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_GRAFFITI_DIARY_RELIC.desc: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to all enemies; if an enemy dies while having [gold]Poison[/gold], its stacks transfer to a random enemy.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE_DIARY_RELIC.desc: At the start of your turn, swap your [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Afterwards, if the two are equal, double both.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_ESCAPE_DIARY_RELIC.title: Escape Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_ESCAPE_DIARY_RELIC.descri: At the start of your turn, each enemy grants you Block equal to your [gold]Diary Count[/gold]; if an enemy with an attack intent is present, the effect is doubled.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_JUSTICE_DIARY_RELIC.title: Justice Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_JUSTICE_DIARY_RELIC.descr: When you lose HP, all enemies take damage equal to twice the HP lost. At the start of combat, mark a random enemy. If that enemy is the first to be killed, gain Max HP equal to the number of diaries you hold.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_JUSTICE_DIARY_RELIC.flavo: The victor is justice! The defeated are evil!
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_CLAIRVOYANCE_RELIC.title: Clairvoyance Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_CLAIRVOYANCE_RELIC.descri: At the start of combat, send the cards in your draw pile to your discard pile.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_FEED_DIARY_RELIC.title: Feeding Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_FEED_DIARY_RELIC.descript: At the start of your turn, based on the first card you played that has [gold]base damage[/gold] or [gold]base block[/gold], apply the following effect: if it is an [gold]attack card[/gold], increase its base damage by [blue]{IncreaseCount:diff()}[/blue]; if it is a [gold]skill card[/gold], increase its base block by [blue]{IncreaseCount:diff()}[/blue]. Only applies this combat.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_THE_WATCHER_RELIC.title: Watcher's Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_THE_WATCHER_RELIC.descrip: At the start of combat, randomly add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Uncommon[/gold] or [gold]Rare[/gold] card with Ethereal from a [gold]non-Yuno card pool[/gold] to your hand; it can be played for free this turn.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_REVOLVER_RELIC.title: Revolver
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_REVOLVER_RELIC.descriptio: When you exit Firearm, deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to all enemies.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_USELESS_CLOCK_RELIC.title: Useless Clock
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_USELESS_CLOCK_RELIC.descr: Once per turn. When you play [gold]Strike[/gold], play a [gold]Defend[/gold] from your draw pile; or when you play [gold]Defend[/gold], play a [gold]Strike[/gold] from your draw pile.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BOOMERANG_RELIC.title: Dartboard
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BOOMERANG_RELIC.descripti: When an enemy dies, transfer its [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] stacks to a random enemy.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEUS_NUCLEUS_RELIC.title: Deus's Core
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEUS_NUCLEUS_RELIC.descri: Each time you gain [blue]1[/blue] Strength, gain [blue]{GetCount:diff()}[/blue] Vigor.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEUS_NUCLEUS_RELIC.flavor: When you gain a point of Strength, then you have gained a point of Strength.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DIAMOND_RING_RELIC.title: Diamond Ring
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DIAMOND_RING_RELIC.descri: The first time you lose HP, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold], and apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_MURUMURU_CROWN_RELIC.desc: At the start of combat, add [blue]1[/blue] Sphere to your deck.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_FLASH_DIARY_RELIC.title: Sparkle Sparkle Diary
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_FLASH_DIARY_RELIC.descrip: Not a Diary relic. At the start of combat, randomly give [blue]1[/blue] card in your draw pile Replay [blue]1[/blue].
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_FLASH_DIARY_RELIC.flavor: It records your shining moments. Because it is a sub-diary, it does not increase your Diary count.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_HYDRANGEA_RELIC.title: Hydrangea
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_HYDRANGEA_RELIC.descripti: The first time you play a card, draw [blue]1[/blue] card and gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_GLOVE_DOLL_RELIC.title: Glove Puppet
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_ANCIENT_SEARCH_DIARY_RELI:
At the start of your turn, gain [blue]Diary Count[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].

When you deal single-target damage to a target with a card, the target gains [gold]Gaze[/gold] and other targets lose [gold]Gaze[/gold].

On pickup, gain [blue]{DiaryCount:diff()}[/blue] random [gold]Diaries[/gold].
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_RED_RELIC.title: Death Message - Red
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_RED_RELIC.descri: When you defeat the first elite of each floor, gain 1 special card.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_PINK_RELIC.title: Death Message - Pink
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_PINK_RELIC.descr: After your first combat victory or after defeating a Boss, gain 1 random Diary.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_YELLOW_RELIC.des: While holding this relic, you can obtain Tarot-series relics. Tarot relics have both an Upright and a Reversed effect; at the start of combat, there is a 90% chance it is Upright and a 10% chance it is Reversed.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT02_THE_HIGH_PRIESTES: At the start of combat, gain 1 Artifact.
At the start of combat, all enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold].
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT00_THE_FOOL_RELIC.de: All [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] cards in your deck cost [blue]0[/blue].
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT00_THE_FOOL_RELIC.fl: Carrying a pack, taking the first step toward the cliff.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT01_THE_MAGICIAN_RELI: At the end of your turn, if the cards you played this turn have [blue]3[/blue] or more different types, remove all your debuffs; if [blue]4[/blue] or more types, remove all Strength from all enemies; if [blue]5[/blue] or more types, gain [blue]999[/blue] Energy next turn. (Types: [gold]attack cards[/gold], [gold]skill cards[/gold], [gold]power cards[/gold], [gold]Status[/gold], [gold]Curse[/gold])
Props on the table, all complete.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT03_THE_EMPRESS_RELIC:
On pickup, gain an effect based on your class:
[gold]Ironclad[/gold]: gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rampage[/gold]; [gold]Rampage[/gold] costs [blue]0[/blue].
[gold]Silent[/gold]: gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Snake Bite[/gold]; [gold]Snake Bite[/gold] affects all enemies.
[gold]Regent[/gold]: gain [blue]1[/blue] upgraded [gold]Armaments[/gold].
[gold]Necrobinder[/gold]: gain [blue]13[/blue] Max HP.
[gold]Defect[/gold]: gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Claw[/gold]; after playing [gold]Claw[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to that damage.
[gold]Other[/gold]: at the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
On the bountiful wheat field, the Empress is crowned.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT04_THE_EMPEROR_RELIC: When you play an [gold]attack card[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary [gold]Strength[/gold]; when you play a [gold]skill card[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Temporary stats disappear at the end of the turn.
Seated firmly on the throne, order prevails.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT05_THE_HIEROPHANT_RE: Gain [blue]20[/blue] Max HP. When you restore HP in combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] Max HP.
Listening to the doctrine, receiving blessing.
When you play an [gold]attack card[/gold], if the previous card you played was a [gold]skill card[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] card; when you play a [gold]skill card[/gold], if the previous card you played was an [gold]attack card[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT07_THE_CHARIOT_RELIC: When an [gold]attack card[/gold] breaks through an enemy's [gold]Block[/gold], inflict [gold]Stun[/gold].
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT08_STRENGTH_RELIC.de: At the end of your turn, enemies below [blue]10[/blue] HP gain [gold]Mercy[/gold]. An enemy with [gold]Mercy[/gold] dies at the end of the next enemy turn and increases the relic counter by [blue]1[/blue]. At the start of combat, gain [gold]Strength Blessing[/gold] equal to the relic counter. When you play a card, consume [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength Blessing[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
Once only, after right-clicking this relic, enter a shop.
Walking alone with a lantern, occasionally stepping into the world's bustle.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT10_WHEEL_OF_FORTUNE_: At the start of your turn, randomly gain [blue]1[/blue]-[blue]6[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. When you take damage, there is a [blue]1[/blue]% chance to reduce the damage taken to [blue]0[/blue].
The wheel of fate is slowly turning.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT11_JUSTICE_RELIC.des: When you deal [gold]single-target damage[/gold] to an enemy with a card, deal [blue]50[/blue]% of that damage to adjacent enemies.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT11_JUSTICE_RELIC.fla: Sword drawn, the guilty cannot escape.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT12_THE_HANGED_MAN_RE: When you lose HP, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
Hanging upside down is also a kind of courage.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT13_DEATH_RELIC.title: Upright 13 - Death
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT13_DEATH_RELIC.descr: Your attacks execute enemies below [blue]10[/blue]% HP, and you gain [blue]25[/blue] Gold.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT13_DEATH_RELIC.flavo: Where the scythe falls, all are equal.
When you gain [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], or [gold]Frail[/gold], apply the same debuff with the same stacks to all enemies.
Sharing joy and sorrow alike; temperance is balance.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT15_THE_DEVIL_RELIC.d: After you die, revive at full HP; afterwards, at the start of your turn take damage equal to [blue]49[/blue]% of your Max HP, and when you attack with a card, deal extra damage equal to [blue]10[/blue]% of the target's Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per game.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT15_THE_DEVIL_RELIC.f: The contract is signed, the soul is the stake.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT16_THE_TOWER_RELIC.d: At the start of your turn, you may Exhaust [blue]1[/blue] card in your hand. When the total number of cards in your draw pile, discard pile, and hand is less than [blue]3[/blue], kill all enemies.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT16_THE_TOWER_RELIC.f: The tall tower crumbles, the old collapses.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT17_THE_STAR_RELIC.de: If the card you play costs [blue]1[/blue] more than the previous card you played, double the damage dealt by the card you play, or double the Block gained.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT17_THE_STAR_RELIC.fl: Following the starlight, climbing step by step.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT18_THE_MOON_RELIC.de: At the start of combat, gain [blue]20[/blue] Gold. When you lose HP due to an enemy attack, lose [blue]5[/blue] Gold.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT18_THE_MOON_RELIC.fl: Under the moonlight, gains and losses flow like the tide.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT00_THE_FOOL_RELIC.re: On the first turn, [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] cost [blue]1[/blue] more.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT01_THE_MAGICIAN_RELI: At the end of your turn, if the number of different card types you played this turn is less than [blue]2[/blue], lose [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT03_THE_EMPRESS_RELIC: The Upright effect is temporarily inactive.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT04_THE_EMPEROR_RELIC: When you play an attack card, all enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary Strength; when you play a skill card, all enemies lose [blue]1[/blue] temporary Strength.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT05_THE_HIEROPHANT_RE: When you lose HP, lose [blue]1[/blue] Max HP.
The Upright effect is temporarily inactive.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT07_THE_CHARIOT_RELIC: Once per combat, when a monster breaks through its own Block, you gain [blue]1[/blue] Vulnerable.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT08_STRENGTH_RELIC.re: The Upright effect is temporarily inactive.
Loses the Upright effect; you cannot enter a shop through this relic.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT10_WHEEL_OF_FORTUNE_: At the start of your turn, enemies have a [blue]1[/blue]% chance to gain [blue]1[/blue] Intangible.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT11_JUSTICE_RELIC.rev: When an enemy gains a debuff, you gain [blue]1[/blue] stack of the same debuff; triggers only once per combat.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT12_THE_HANGED_MAN_RE: When you lose HP due to an enemy's attack, that enemy restores HP equal to that amount.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT13_DEATH_RELIC.rever: If your attack fails to deal damage to an enemy, lose [blue]2[/blue] Gold.
When an enemy has no debuffs but has buffs, damage dealt to you is increased by [blue]25[/blue]%.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT15_THE_DEVIL_RELIC.r: After an enemy dies, it revives at full HP, and at the start of the enemy's turn it takes damage equal to [blue]50[/blue]% of its Max HP; triggers only once per combat.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT16_THE_TOWER_RELIC.r: At the start of combat, add a copy of each card in your draw pile to your discard pile.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT17_THE_STAR_RELIC.re: The Upright effect is temporarily inactive.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT18_THE_MOON_RELIC.re: When you lose HP due to an enemy attack, lose [blue]5[/blue] Gold.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT19_THE_SUN_RELIC.rev: At the start of combat, place all Curse cards on top of your draw pile.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT20_JUDGEMENT_RELIC.r: The Upright effect is temporarily inactive.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TAROT21_THE_WORLD_RELIC.r: When you play your [blue]12[/blue]th card, end your turn; triggers only once per combat.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_BLUE_RELIC.title: Death Message - Blue
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_GREEN_RELIC.desc: When obtained, gain all Tarot-series relics.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_DEAD_END_PURPLE_RELIC.des: When obtained, choose 1 card from all Special cards to add to your deck.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_BAO_HU_SHE_YAO_RELIC.desc: At the start of combat, add a [gold]Snakebite[/gold] to your hand. At the start of your turn, for each [gold]Snakebite[/gold] in your hand, apply [blue]{BaoHuSheYao_PoisonCount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_LIE_REN_SHA_SHOU_SHA_SHOU: At the start of combat, if a [gold]Hunter Killer[/gold] is present in the room, gain: for each card played this turn, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Based on the number of cards played in a combat, the following effects apply: at [blue]{LieRenShaShouShaShou_GetBlockAmount}[/blue]: gain [blue]5[/blue] Block. At [blue]{LieRenShaShouShaShou_GetHeal}[/blue]: heal [blue]{LieRenShaShouShaShou_GetHealAmount}[/blue] HP. At [blue]{LieRenShaShouShaShou_GetPower}[/blue]: gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. At [blue]{LieRenShaShouShaShou_ExtraDraw}[/blue]: draw [blue]2[/blue] additional cards each turn. At [blue]{LieRenShaShouShaShou_ExtraEnergy}[/blue]: gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy each turn.
The Hunter Killer Protection Society strongly protests!
YUNO_MOD_RELIC_TIE_BO_ZHAN_AI_HAO_ZHE_RE: Add a [gold]Iron Wave[/gold] to your deck, then remove all [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold] from your deck. For each card removed, add another [gold]Iron Wave[/gold] to your deck.
